# Lucide static subset

Version: 0.468.0 (pinned release).
Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0/icons
License: ISC; upstream LICENSE is included verbatim (including the Feather copyright notice).

Only the SVG child nodes used by the glance tiles and current weather are copied into icons.js; no runtime, npm package, or external font is needed. SVG attributes and geometry are unchanged. Fixed tints and semantic aliases live in twin/live/glance_icons.js.

Icons: sun, house, battery, battery-charging, car, plug-zap, utility-pole, plug, thermometer, droplet, droplets, flame, fan, snowflake, lightbulb, lock, door-open, panels-top-left, warehouse, camera, shield, wifi, server, trash-2, washing-machine, wind, utensils-crossed, cooking-pot, tv, speaker, shower-head, waves, leaf, cloud, gauge, clock, person-standing, paw-print, bell, power, moon, cloud-sun, cloud-rain, cloud-rain-wind, cloud-snow, cloud-fog, cloud-lightning, cloud-drizzle.


Added 2026-11-12: `layers` and `zap` SVG nodes from npm `lucide-static@0.468.0` (tarball sha512 integrity verified against the registry), copied unchanged as node lists.
